summary: The tutorial covers how to use LibreOffice Writer for document viewing and printing. It explains how to open the document in various modes such as Full Screen and Web Layout for better viewing. The tutorial also demonstrates how to insert page breaks using Insert Menu and Break options. It discusses zoom functions to adjust the display size of the document and fit pages to the window. Additionally, it shows how to change the layout and orientation of the document, including portrait and landscape settings. The tutorial covers features like Fit to Width and Fit to Height, which help in adjusting the display of multiple pages. It also explains how to switch between single and multiple pages in the View menu for better editing and viewing experience. Overall, the tutorial provides a comprehensive guide on utilizing different viewing and editing options in LibreOffice Writer.
